Generate a guided rendehR setup script

Source: R/setup_assistant.R
ehr_setup_assistant.Rd

ehr_setup_assistant() is a console-first guide. It explains the main setup decisions, asks for choices when run interactively, and returns a runnable R script. It does not download data, write schemas, edit credentials, or run the pipeline itself. The generated script is the artifact to review, save, and run block by block.

Usage

ehr_setup_assistant(
  src_name = NULL,
  source_size = NULL,
  engine = NULL,
  db_name = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  data_dir = NULL,
  config_setup = NULL,
  include_disk_check = NULL,
  cohort = NULL,
  icd_filter_path = NULL,
  pipeline = NULL,
  include_download = NULL,
  raw_data_dir = NULL,
  run_comorbidities = NULL,
  run_iss = NULL,
  analysis_level = NULL,
  make_icu_timeline = NULL,
  window_before_hours = NULL,
  window_after_hours = NULL,
  include_other_icu_events = NULL,
  include_date_only_events = NULL,
  materialize_icu = NULL,
  merge = NULL,
  target_schema = NULL,
  inspect_options = NULL,
  load_method = NULL,
  package_path = getwd(),
  save_script = NULL,
  setup_script_path = NULL,
  overwrite_setup_script = FALSE,
  interactive = base::interactive(),
  import_scope = NULL,
  sepsis_bundle = NULL,
  memory_limit = NULL,
  threads = NULL
)

Arguments

src_name

Optional source name or character vector of source names. When NULL, the assistant asks first whether to use demo or full sources, then lets the user choose one or more sources.

source_size

Source size mode: "demo" or "full". Demo is recommended for first tests because it is small and should not require PhysioNet credentials.

engine

Database backend for the generated script: "postgres" (default) runs the complete pipeline, or "duckdb" for cohort selection and raw loading only (no Postgres server needed for that part). Compatible concept layers support DuckDB separately; this assistant does not generate them. Harmonization, comorbidities, ISS, clinical/ SCI annotations, and merge_sources() all require PostgreSQL and are omitted from the generated script when engine = "duckdb"; pipeline is forced to "stages" (run_one_source() still uses PostgreSQL for loading and downstream stages), and run_comorbidities/run_iss/merge/inspect_options are forced off since they all require PostgreSQL.

db_name

Database name stored in project config. DuckDB loading does not open a PostgreSQL connection.

base_dir

Project root directory to place in generated code. Holds config, SQL, and generated files.

data_dir

Directory for large data: raw PhysioNet downloads and cohort parquet outputs. When NULL, the assistant asks interactively and defaults to file.path(base_dir, "data"). Raw downloads go to its physionet_data subfolder and cohort parquet to its cohorts_data subfolder. Point this at a large disk to keep the heavy files off the project directory.

config_setup

Project config handling mode: "manual" creates missing templates for the user to edit, "interactive" creates missing config from assistant answers, and "skip" requires existing config. Existing files are preserved; generated code stops on conflicting settings. The old value "template" is accepted as an alias for "manual".

include_disk_check

Include a read-only disk-space check snippet in the generated script? Mainly useful for full-data runs.

cohort

Cohort mode: "scid", "sepsis3", "custom", or "none".

icd_filter_path

Path to a custom ICD filter file when cohort = "custom".

pipeline

Pipeline style: "stages" emits stage-by-stage calls; "full" emits run_one_source() when possible.

include_download

Include a download_source() block in the script?

raw_data_dir

Optional parent raw-data storage root (source directories live underneath it). Used consistently for downloads, config and import.

run_comorbidities

Include the Charlson/Elixhauser comorbidity stage in the generated build script? Defaults to TRUE for SCI, FALSE otherwise.

run_iss

Include the Injury Severity Score (ISS/NISS) stage in the generated build script? Defaults to TRUE for SCI, FALSE otherwise.

analysis_level

Desired unit of analysis: "admission" for hospital admission/native-grain analysis, or "icu" for ICU-stay analysis. This matches the analysis_level values used across the package (e.g. merge_sources(), get_patient_ts()). "hadm" is accepted as a deprecated alias for "admission".

make_icu_timeline

Deprecated/compatibility shortcut. If supplied and analysis_level is NULL, TRUE maps to analysis_level = "icu" and FALSE maps to analysis_level = "admission".

window_before_hours

Hours before ICU admission to include in the ICU projection block.

window_after_hours

Hours after ICU discharge to include in the ICU projection block.

include_other_icu_events

Include ICU-native events from other ICU stays when they fall inside the requested ICU window?

include_date_only_events

Include date-only events in the ICU projection?

materialize_icu

If TRUE, generate a table for ts_icu; if FALSE, generate a view.

merge

Merge mode: "none", "admission", or "icu".

target_schema

Target schema for the optional merge block.

inspect_options

Character vector of post-build inspect/analyze snippets to include. Choices are "tables", "cohort", "concepts", "patient_timeline", "descriptive", and "none".

load_method

How the generated script should load rendehR: "library", "load_all", or "none".

package_path

Package path used when load_method = "load_all".

save_script

Save the generated script to disk? When NULL and interactive, the assistant asks at the end. When non-interactive, NULL is treated as FALSE.

setup_script_path

Path where the generated script should be saved. Defaults to file.path(base_dir, "ehr_setup_script.R") when saving.

overwrite_setup_script

Overwrite an existing saved script? Default FALSE.

interactive

If TRUE, print the guide and prompt for missing values. If FALSE, use defaults and return the generated plan silently.

import_scope

Surrounding data to retain: "patient", "hospital", or "icu". Choices cannot be finer than any selected source's cohort key. Defaults to hospital for Sepsis-3, patient otherwise. Unfiltered mode only accepts patient. Context encounters do not automatically become members.

sepsis_bundle

Sepsis-3 variant: "sepsis3", "first_sepsis3", "sepsis3_admission", or "first_sepsis3_admission". Only for sepsis3.

memory_limit

Optional DuckDB memory size, e.g. "4GB", for sepsis selection/import.

threads

Optional positive integer worker count for sepsis selection/import.

Value

An object of class ehr_setup_plan with choices, script, and next_steps fields.

Examples

project <- file.path(tempdir(), "rendehr-project")
plan <- ehr_setup_assistant(base_dir = project, interactive = FALSE)
cat(plan$script)
#> # Generated by ehr_setup_assistant().
#> # Review this script and run it block by block in your own R session.
#> # The assistant printed this code; it did not run downloads or write to the database.
#> 
#> # Step 0 - Load rendehR --------------------------------------------------
#> # Use library(rendehR) after installation, or devtools::load_all() while developing locally.
#> library(rendehR)
#> 
#> # Step 1 - Set parameters ------------------------------------------------
#> # src_names can contain one source or several sources.
#> # Every pipeline call below passes src_name explicitly.
#> # base_dir is the project root (config, SQL, generated files); created here if missing.
#> # data_dir is for the large files (raw downloads, cohort parquet, DuckDB); point it at a large disk.
#> # raw_data_root, cohort_parquet_root, and duckdb_root are stored in the config so every stage uses them.
#> src_names <- c("mimic_iv_demo")
#> default_src <- src_names[[1]]
#> db_name <- "rendehr"
#> base_dir <- "/tmp/Rtmpew7WRg/rendehr-project"
#> data_dir <- "/tmp/Rtmpew7WRg/rendehr-project/data"
#> raw_data_root <- file.path(data_dir, 'physionet_data')
#> cohort_parquet_root <- file.path(data_dir, 'cohorts_data')
#> duckdb_root <- file.path(data_dir, 'duckdb')
#> import_scope <- "patient"
#> # Patient: retain all available encounters for selected patients; uses more storage.
#> # Imported context does not automatically become cohort membership.
#> if (!dir.exists(base_dir)) dir.create(base_dir, recursive = TRUE)
#> if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE)
#> 
#> # Step 1b - Project config ------------------------------------------------

sepsis <- ehr_setup_assistant(base_dir = project, cohort = "sepsis3",
  import_scope = "hospital", sepsis_bundle = "first_sepsis3_admission",
  interactive = FALSE)
sci <- ehr_setup_assistant(base_dir = project, cohort = "scid",
  import_scope = "hospital", interactive = FALSE)
